summary: Master Digital Operating Model Design to align strategy with operations. Build TOMs, map value streams, and implement DevOps workflows. Enroll now for hands-on
lede: Digital operating model design aligns digital strategy with the processes, technology, people and governance needed to deliver it. For IT strategists, transformation managers and operating model professionals, the course covers assessing digital maturity, mapping value streams to find bottlenecks, and designing a target operating model; learners also practice DevOps workflows and roadmap prioritization with KPIs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must design, implement, or optimize digital operating models to align strategy with operations.
modules: Foundations of Digital Operating Model Design
Assessing Current State and Value Stream Mapping
Stakeholder Mapping and Change Impact Analysis
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of IT strategy concepts and basic understanding of digital transformation drivers. No coding required. Participants should bring a laptop for hands-on exercises using digital templates and value stream mapping tools.
